purpose: The front page of the corpus: a tag-filter row and a wall of 47 real-site cards, and a route() that turns each site name into its own page.
duplicates: public/layouts/browse/ - both are a filterable wall of previews with clickable tags
should_use: framework/ext/catalog browse() - page.js:52 names it and deliberately hand-rolls corpus() instead

thing: Site page class (record renderer + live viewer)
purpose: Builds one site page from its json record: four shots, sections, tags, the wire drawing, and a live frame you can resize.
duplicates: public/layouts/Layout.js - parallel record-to-page class with the same tag/slug helpers
framework/ext/Draggable + grip - a resizable frame is a common need (not checked whether Site.js reuses it)
should_use: framework/ext/grip - the resizable live-frame viewer at Site.js:262 probably hand-rolls its own resize handle (not verified)

purpose: One json per real website plus five jpegs (400, 1280, 1920, 3440, long); the evidence that cites layout ids. 47 records, 47 with a wire drawing, about 39 MB of images.
The generated manifest every page reads (sites, tags, sections); written by tools/index.mjs, never by hand.
Three Node scripts that photograph a site at four widths, measure its DOM and CSS, and build the manifest; they never run in the browser.
duplicates: public/framework/ext/DesignTool/vision/ - also shoots pages with headless Chromium (different target: our own site)

purpose: Counts the whole corpus at render time: most common layouts at 1920 and 400, how they collapse, and a prose page of the best examples.
duplicates: public/layouts/ - the layout encyclopedia describes the same layouts, this counts them across sites

purpose: Click a tag and see every site that carries it; a route() page, not declared in children.
readme_why: No readme.md in tag/; the front readme only touches on tags.
duplicates: public/layouts/tag/page.js - same click-a-tag navigation over layouts.json instead of site records

purpose: The detail behind the readme: the record contract, the tag vocabulary, what the tools measure, and design decisions.
A hand-written wire field on each site record that draws the page with the content taken out; the drawing spec lives in /layouts/doc/wire/.
duplicates: public/layouts/doc/wire/ - the spec; layout entries draw the same wires (imagine/design also has layout demos, overlap not checked)
